metadata.scenario: A man calls for the first time asking about speech therapy services for his mother who had a stroke. He asks about frequency, duration of sessions, and cost. The receptionist provides a quote for twice-weekly sessions at $95 each. He sounds hopeful and wants to start next week. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Mark Johnson. I'm looking for information about speech therapy services for my mother. She had a stroke recently. I'm sorry to hear about your mother, Mark. We do offer speech therapy services. Great! Can you tell me about the frequency and duration of the sessions? Typically, our sessions are scheduled twice a week, lasting about 45 to 60 minutes each. That sounds good. How much do the sessions cost? The cost for each session is between $95 and $125, depending on the specific requirements. So, if I want to schedule twice a week, that would be about $190 to $250 weekly? Yes, that's correct. Would you like to go ahead and schedule those sessions? Yes, I would love to start next week. What do I need to do to set that up? I can assist you with that. I’ll need to gather some information about your mother and her specific needs. Sure, what do you need from me? Can you provide your mother’s name, her current health status, and any relevant medical history? Her name is Alice Johnson. She’s recovering but has some difficulty speaking and swallowing. Thank you, Mark. And is there a preferred time for the sessions? Mornings would be best for us. Alright, I can check our therapist’s schedule for you. That sounds perfect. In addition to speech therapy, would you also be interested in our transportation services for her appointments? Yes, that could be really helpful as well. What are the rates for transportation? Our transportation services range from $45 to $65 per trip. Okay, I’ll need that too. Great! Just to summarize, we’ll set up speech therapy twice weekly starting next week and arrange transportation. Yes, that’s right. Perfect, I’ll get this information into our system and give you a call back shortly with the schedule. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. My pleasure, Mark! If you have any other questions in the meantime, feel free to call back. Will do. Thanks again! You're welcome! Have a great day. You too, bye! Goodbye!
